dedupe_keys.name: building energy storage simulation gymnasium environment for battery control in a building

description: Building Energy Storage Simulation is a gymnasium environment for reinforcement learning, successor to OpenAI gym, that represents a building with a battery and a solar energy system connected to a grid with time-varying prices. The load is covered first by solar power and then from the grid, and the agent's task is to charge and discharge the battery so that the total cost of electricity is as low as possible. The idea and the data profiles come from CityLearn, while this project aims for ease of use and a simple implementation, as a playground for starting with reinforcement learning in energy management. Coverage: one generic building. Access: free on GitHub and PyPI. Licence: MIT. Caveats: a single simplified building; last commit January 2024. Simulation uses are testing battery control policies for building energy cost and backup capacity. Related records: the CityLearn environment and datasets.
inputs: Building load and solar generation profiles (from CityLearn)
name: Building Energy Storage Simulation: gymnasium environment for battery control in a building
outputs: Electricity cost and grid import under a control policy
